verdict.rationale: Stripe's Workbench ships its own interactive Shell with a built-in API Explorer. In it you can visually explore API resources, build API calls with tab completion, and run real requests in the browser. Those runs are limited to sandboxes, since the Shell is read-only in live mode. The evidence ties this to the Dashboard, not to a public API reference page with embedded runnable examples, so the 'API reference' part is only partly shown. Missing for 10: evidence that the public API reference docs themselves carry runnable or try-it examples, any detail on per-endpoint example snippets, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API Explorer experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: API Explorer: Use the built-in API Explorer to visually explore API resources and build API calls from Shell.
